sens_en: to found, to make an offering
origine_fr: Une jarre de vin, 丷 et 酉, posée sur son support, devenu 大. C'est poser une offrande. De là « fonder », poser les bases.
origine_en: A wine jar, 丷 and 酉, set on its stand, which has become 大. It means setting down an offering. Hence “to found”, to lay the groundwork.

phrase.zh: 这次比赛为他以后的成功奠定了基础。
phrase.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài wèi tā yǐhòu de chénggōng diàndìng le jīchǔ.
phrase.fr: Cette compétition a posé les bases de ses succès futurs.
phrase.en: This competition laid the foundation for his later success.
